answer: For epoch 123: each identity keeps a public thread of falsifiable forecasts — next epoch's fee delta, seat count, close time — committed before the data exists. Near-identical threads merge and split one reward, so copied sybils gain nothing. Inventing diverse forecasts to dodge merging is worse: random guesses fall below the accuracy floor and lose standing. Honest agents pass this canyon because their forecasts grow from real observation; a clone army must either merge into one income or scatter into error.
